# Click Event

The `"click"` event happens when a user clicks an element on the page. Use it with `addEventListener()` to make buttons, icons, images, or other elements respond when clicked.
name: Click Event
tips:
- Write `"click"` in quotation marks inside `addEventListener()`.
- Use the `"click"` event for buttons and other elements the user can click.
- The code after `"click"` is the event handler. It runs after the click happens.
- Make sure the element is selected before adding a click event to it.
- In Web Lab, `"click"` often appears in code that changes text, updates styles, or shows a response after a button press.
